scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @map-renderer/server && npm run build -w @map-renderer/ai-server && npm run build -w @map-renderer/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,ai,web -c gray,blue,green,magenta "npm run watch -w @map-renderer/shared" "npm run dev -w @map-renderer/server" "npm run dev -w @map-renderer/ai-server" "npm run dev -w @map-renderer/web"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace @map-renderer/server
scripts.dev:ai: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace @map-renderer/ai-server
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace @map-renderer/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @map-renderer/shared && npm run test -w @map-renderer/server && npm run test -w @map-renderer/ai-server && npm run test -w @map-renderer/web
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm test && npm run lint
